body.statement: Under the cohort-stratified repeated-cross-section design, \(Z\sim\mathcal N(Kx,\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}})\) exactly. In particular, \(\operatorname{Cov}(Z_{g,t},Z_{h,s})=(\sigma^2/N)[\mathbf 1\{t=s\}(\mathbf 1\{g=h\}/q_g+1/q_{>t})+\sum_{a=1}^Tb_{(g,t),a}b_{(h,s),a}/q_a]\). The first term records contemporaneous control-pool exhaustion and the Gram term records the shared nested baseline contrasts.
body.justification: The exact covariance turns disappearance of controls into a computable information problem.
body.gap: Sant'Anna and Zhao derive a two-period repeated-cross-section influence function; this lemma gives the exact growing-calendar covariance of nested not-yet-treated scores.
body.consumer: A staggered event-study analyst can compute the covariance input from cohort shares and cell counts.
